request.purpose: Normalize all Single League domestic competition keys by removing country segment in Results and Match Report
statements: UPDATE `GW001_IMC Results` SET competition_key=CONCAT('GW001|',SUBSTRING_INDEX(competition_key,'|',-3)) WHERE competition_key REGEXP '^GW001\\|[^|]+\\|DOMESTIC\\|'
UPDATE `GW001_IMC Match Report` SET competition_key=CONCAT('GW001|',SUBSTRING_INDEX(competition_key,'|',-3)) WHERE competition_key REGEXP '^GW001\\|[^|]+\\|DOMESTIC\\|'
